methodology.sampling: equal time per case/library; median across independent Node processes; alternating group/operation order and rotating library order
methodology.allocation: all outputs escape through a 32-slot sink, natural GC included; no forced GC; memory not benchmarked
methodology.rounding: HALF_EVEN; division/sqrt final output 20 decimal places; exact +/-/*/cube
methodology.decimalAdaptation: operation-specific cloned constructors; exact precision sufficient for all digits; div/sqrt/chain precision sized for integer digits + 20 decimal places + 10 guard digits; toDP(20) included in timing
methodology.scope: fixed mixed-sign/scale inputs on Node, no browser or arbitrary-input correctness guarantee from benchmark preflight
